name: Animation
description:
Also known as Crafting, Animators use their knowledge of
materials and the mysterious terrigan marks to bestow
volition into constructs of base matter, fashioning
murgolems to serve as servants or protectors.

name: Archery
description:
Thought to be the legacy of the lost Anomani, the art of
Archery teaches any bow or crossbow user to attune them-
selves to their weapon and to the spirits of the very
winds, increasing their shots' accuracy, range, and power.

name: Athletics
description:
Fighting or fleeing, your own body can be your deadliest
enemy, for fatigue leads to ruin as sure as an opponent's
strength. These regimens of exercises increase the body's
 capacity for exertion, keeping exhaustion at bay.

name: Axe Mastery
description:
Before Malog the Warrior fell from grace none could rival
his mastery of the axe. Only the faintest glimmers of
Malog's techniques are remembered today, but any who can
learn and master them become terrible in combat.

name: Axe
description:
Many dismiss the axe as a brutish weapon, but the Dwarves 
and the Invorri of the frozen north have long favored 
axes above all other weapons. Careful practice transforms
an axe from a crude chopper to the deadliest of weapons.

name: Bardsong
description:
There is power in words and names, and music has greater
power still. By memorizing ancient epics and learning the
deeds of heroes of legend, Bards learn to sway the wills
 and stir the hearts of mortals with the songs they sing.

name: Bargaining
description:
Seller beware! A keen eye, and quick wit can convince even
the stingiest merchant to undercut some of the profit they
covet. The merchant princes of Tariponto make haggling an
art form. The frugal can learn much from their example.

name: Beastcraft
description:
The Rangers practice the ways of Beastcraft, a balance of
the teachings of Kenaryn the Hunter and the rites of the
Beast Lords, Kenaryn's deadly enemies. The boons of the
Hunter and the Beasts give Rangers power over the wild.

name: Benediction
description:
All of Aerynth's Gods bestow favors upon their faithful,
dispensing boons through their chosen servants.
Benediction is the path of boons and blessings, born of
faithful introspection and observation of rite and custom.

name: Blade Mastery
description:
Equal parts religion and training regimen, the ancient way known as
Jen'e'tai (the Path of Truth in a long forgotten tongue)
looks back to the teachings of Draethen Truesword, who
forged a fighting style as deadly as it is beautiful.

name: Blade Weaving
description:
The first Blade Weavers danced their dance of death before
the creation of the Sun, taught by the mightiest of the ancient Sidhe.
Always in motion, Blade Weavers use speed and fluidity
to baffle their foes, then strike with their twin blades.

name: Block
description:
Merely carrying a shield will aid one's defense in combat,
but with careful practice a defender learns how to put
their shield to its best use. Seasoned defenders anti-
cipate blows and block them before they ever fall.

name: Bow
description:
Kenaryn the Hunter, faithful companion to the All-Father, 
first taught the Elves and Centaurs to use bows. Effective
marksmanship requires strength of arm, keen eyes, and a
steady hand, but ranged attacks grant a great advantage.

name: Channeling
description:
All things arise from the interaction of the Five Primal
Elements, bound by the All-Father wove into a pattern.
Those with the gift of Channeling use faith or philosophy
to manipulate the threads of the Tapestry.

name: Conditioning
description:
Healers and Apothecaries have long known that the flow of
blood and other humors is the primary agent of healing.
Learning the ways of herblore and the proper ways to bind
and dress wounds speeds recovery from physical injury.

name: Crossbow
description:
Dwarves made the first crossbows, but their use has spread 
to all the peoples of the world. Simpler than bows
to use, crossbows still require practice and skill to
maintain, load, and shoot effectively.

name: Dagger Mastery
description:
The smallest blades, when used by true masters, can be as
deadly as Drake's claws. The pinnacle of blade fighting,
Dagger Mastery teaches swiftness, balance, and anatomy:
sliced arteries bleed the mightiest foes to certain doom.

name: Dagger
description:
Preferred by thieves, assassins, and the Irekei, daggers
lack size and raw power, but their speed can make them
deadly in the hands of a skilled wielder. As any seasoned
knife fighter knows, it's not a blade's size, it's where you drive it.

name: Dodge
description:
The great Warlord Harthool Klin once said, 'There is no
shame in evasion, for surely the best defense is not to be
there.' Lightly armored defenders learn to avoid their
foes' attacks, leaving nothing to hit but empty air.

name: Dueling
description:
The Free Cities of Tariponto are famed for the dozens of
dueling styles that have arisen there. All Duelists favor
light blades and shun armor. Each style claims to be the
pinnacle of the art, using complex feints and swift jabs.

name: Enchantment
description:
Ancient Magi discovered the power of Sigils, magical signs
that serve as traps for mystic energy. The modern science
of Enchantment allows skilled practitioners to engrave
mundane items with Sigils, giving them magical powers.

name: Endurance
description:
Soldiers and athletes practice many techniques to increase
their natural endurance, quickening recovery from exertion
or fatigue. Devotion to rigid exercise regimens inures
 one to fatigue, bringing spent wind back faster.

name: Flame Calling
description:
The Irekei believe all their strength arises from their hot
blood, for in it is locked the khar'ika, the Soul Flame.
Blood Prophets learn through painful ordeal to tap the power in their
blood, unleashing their khar'ika to either heal or harm.

name: Focus
description:
Both Priests and Wizards describe magic in terms of mana, a
being's capacity for supernatural power. Mental focus is
the key to illumination, an inner awakening to increase
the mana within any spell caster.

name: Great Axe Mastery
description:
It is said that the Dwarves forged the first great axes to
slay Giants during the War of the Stones. Too heavy for
many men to even lift, great axes can cleave foes from
skull to hip, and true masters are fearsome opponents.

name: Great Hammer Mastery
description:
It takes far more than brute strength to wield a maul or
great mace in battle. Two-handed weapons can overbalance
an unskilled user, leaving them open to attack. Masters
overcome this problem, shattering granite when they swing.

name: Great Sword Mastery
description:
Legends still tell of Ardan and his dread sword Virrunor,
whose blade was longer than a man's height and forged of
solid silver. The mightiest heroes strive to follow the
First King, whirling flamberges with the ease of a foil.

name: Hammer Mastery
description:
Northmen sing many songs of Torvald the Titan, first Storm
Lord, whose mighty hammer Dornyngur split the skulls of
Giants and humbled Morloch in battle. Devotion to the
hammer will give you might and skill to rival Torvald's.

name: Hammer
description:
Thurin's weapon, hammers are most common among Dwarves
and the Barbarians of the northlands. Training teaches a
hammer wielder to channel all of their body's strength into a swing,
and hammers are feared for their stunning power.

name: Leadership
description:
There is strength in numbers, but groups only reach their
full potential through strong leadership. Observation,
communication, and empathy: these qualities make a good
leader, and also help one learn from working with others.
This skill grants a bonus to experience earned by large 
groups (4+ players).

name: Learning
description:
Experience is the greatest of teachers, but too many ignore
her lessons. The Skalds of the Invorri and the Archmages
of the Elves are famed for their memories. Mnemonic
 devotion ensures that life's lessons are fully learned.

name: Liturgy
description:
Though the All-Father's voice has been silent since the
Turning, His faithful still look to the power of His
servants, the Blessed Saints and Holy Archons, for aid.
The Holy Church's Liturgy offers Prelates and Crusaders
the means to bless their flocks and smite evil.

name: Meditation
description:
Frenzied thoughts impede the flow of supernatural power.
Breathing exercises and calm meditation clear the waking
mind of all distractions, allowing a caster to quickly
 recover from mystic exertions.

name: Nature Lore
description:
Ancient beyond reckoning is the Old Faith, the cult of
Braialla the Green Mother. Through all the Ages the
Druids have learned the ways of the nature goddess, using
the secrets of Nature Lore to keep the world in balance.

name: Opening
description:
The mysterious Runegates still baffle the wisest and most
learned of Magi, but since the Turning their uses have been revealed.
The Aracoix taught scholars the art of Opening, whereby
the learned may open portals to other Runegates.

name: Parry
description:
The line between offense and defense is as thin as a hair.
Any melee weapon can also act as a shield, turning attacks on
blade or haft. Such music springs from steel on steel!

name: Pole Arm Mastery
description:
The Paragons, the immortal Centaurs who lived before the
dawn of Time, first invented and used pole arms. Few have
ever matched the Horselords' skill with these mighty
weapons, but any who learn their ways are mighty foes.

name: Pole Arm
description:
The length and weight of pole arms make them notoriously
difficult to use, but those who have the strength and
discipline can turn these weakness into strengths. The
techniques used by Ardan's armies are still deadly today.

name: Restoration
description:
The power to create resides with all of the Gods, and bound
together with it is the power to mend and heal. All whose
souls are touched by the divine can nurture the healing
powers of Restoration with faith, mending the bodies and spirits.

name: Runecarving
description:
The All-Father set Fate in motion with the Runes of Power.
Though no mortal knows the Runes' full potential, many
among the Dwarves, Invorri and Giants study Runecarving,
 unleashing powerful magic through mystic signs.

name: Running
description:
Victory or even survival often goes to the swiftest. Master
of the chase, Kenaryn first taught the Elves and Centaurs
how to quicken their pace through practice and careful
 exercise. With work, you can become as fleet as a falcon.

name: Shadowmastery
description:
The dark arts of the Assassins combine craft at stealth and
anatomy with long-forbidden sorceries and forgotten Elvish
Necromancy. True Shadowmasters can draw forth the cold
 Darkness of the Outer Void to slay their victims.

name: Shapechanging
description:
Within the soul of every Man there lurks a Beast, raging in
confinement. Few ever hear the voice of that Beast, or
learn to heed its call. Those that do, however, become
Shapechangers, donning the skins of animals or darker shapes.

name: Sorcery
description:
The first pillar of Magery, Sorcery is the ancient art
dealing with the Primal force of Chaos. Students of
Sorcery use the principles of randomness and decay to
blast their foes and generate spectacular effects.

name: Spear Mastery
description:
Trilius Truespear, one of the mightiest Centaurs who ever
lived, learned the way of the spear from Kenaryn himself.
Trilius never lost a battle, and his mighty spear humbled
even Demons. Will you strive to match Truespear's skill?

name: Spear
description:
The second favored weapon of Kenaryn the Hunter, spears are
common weapons among hunters, soldiers, and the Amazons.
Trained wielders know how to use a spear in close combat,
and can skewer foes through even the heaviest armor.

name: Staff Mastery
description:
In the hands of a master, a staff is as deadly as a blade,
striking with blinding speed to stun, hamper, or cripple
opponents. Few have the patience to devote themselves to
the Way of the Staff, but those who do are worthy foes.

name: Staff
description:
Easy to craft and wield, staves are often dismissed as
peasant and wizard weapons. Their humble origins belie
their power: a trained user can crack bones with a well-
timed strike, and an ankle sweep can topple any opponent.

name: Stormcalling
description:
The strange art of the Furies, Stormcalling looks to the
Fury locked inside all things. By breaking the natural
form of an object its power can be released, manifesting
as storms and powerful curses.

name: Summoning
description:
There is power in a name: to own a thing's True Name and
utter it is to create a thing entire. Summoners have spent
ages divining the True Names of beasts and monsters, and
use the art of Summoning to call creatures to their aid.

name: Sword Mastery
description:
Masters know that a sword is more than a point and an edge.
In a master's hands a sword becomes an extension of the
mind, moving to attack or defense without thought, finding
 the gaps in any defense, cleaving flesh and steel alike.

name: Sword
description:
Ages of warfare have made swords all too common on the face
of Aerynth. Would you learn the discipline of steel?
Beware: the Way of the Sword, it is said, leads both to
glory and to death.

name: Thaumaturgy
description:
Uvoriel, Archon of Fire, revealed new gospel to St. Malorn,
founder of the Temple of the Cleansing Flame. Thaumaturgy
draws upon faith and the righteous power of the Cleansing
 Flame, giving Confessors and Templars their holy power.

name: Theurgy
description:
While any touched by the divine can use the lesser powers
of Benediction and Restoration, true devotees of a God
achieve communion with their Patron, drawing upon the
gift of Thuergy to invest themselves with divine power.

name: Throwing
description:
Archers aren't the only ones who deal death at a distance.
Whether throwing a knife, axe, or hammer, practice hones
a master's accuracy and teaches them to aim for vital
areas, slaying foes with even the smallest weapons.

name: Toughness
description:
Pain can be controlled: the ordered mind disconnects it.
The origins of the Pragna Techniques are lost, but their
echoes are still used today. Pragna initiates learn to
ignore pain, taking more injuries before they fall.

name: Unarmed Combat Mastery
description:
Exercise, meditation, and training bring masters of unarmed
combat far beyond mere brawling: their very bodies become
weapons.

name: Unarmed Combat
description:
When all else fails, even the mightiest warriors resort to
the weapons they were born with: their fists and feet.
Although anyone can brawl with a foe, there are some who
have made an art of killing with only punches and kicks.

name: Warding
description:
The second pillar of Magery, Warding allows Magi to draw
upon the Cosmic power of Law, using the principles of
order and stability to erect magical defenses, impose
their will on others, and work other powerful effects.

name: Warlockry
description:
The Age of Strife has seen the rise of a new form of magic:
Warlockry, the power to control the minds of others and
manipulate the world through will alone. Some born to the
New Order see themselves as the vanished Gods' heirs.

name: Way of the Gaana
description:
Phaedra, first of the Amazons, learned the Way of the Gaana
from many teachers during her long journey south. Hevralis
the Titan, Saedron, and Vashteera, Beast Lord of Panthers
all grant Huntresses power of born of beasts and the wild.

name: Wear Armor, Heavy
description:
Stiff plates of steel offer considerable protection against
injury, but even this is only a beginning. Practice can
teach a combatant to evade and counter even inside the
heaviest armor, increasing its value in combat.

name: Wear Armor, Light
description:
Even the crudest armor offers some defense against injury,
but armor's raw protection is only a beginning. Practice
 can teach a combatant to move and evade in light armor,
 making light armor as effective as a coat of mail.

name: Wear Armor, Medium
description:
Mail offers its wearer good defense against injury, but raw
protection is only a beginning. Practice can teach you how
to offer only the most fortified areas to your enemy,
 increasing your armor's worth in combat.

name: Wizardry
description:
To achieve true mastery of magic, the twin forces of Law
and Chaos must be bound into one. Wizardry is the highest
of the magical arts, drawing upon both Cosmic Forces and
the Primal Elements to work mighty spells.

name: Corruption
description:
Sorcery, the 'art of Chaos' Magi cling to, is but a beginning. 
Those who embrace the Dark Lords are gifted with the art of 
Corruption, unleashing cataclysmic change and mutation through 
the power of raw Chaos.

name: Abjuration
description:
Nandramiel, Archon of Judgment, revealed unto Saint Heroth the 
Vigilant the Nine Holy Bindings, words of power that overpower 
the will of evildoers who hear them. The Bindings are the Sentinels' 
greatest weapon against Chaos.

name: Way of the Wolf
description:
Within the soul of every Man there lurks a Beast, raging in
confinement. Few ever hear the voice of that Beast, or
learn to heed its call. Those that do, however, become
Shapechangers, donning the skins of animals or darker shapes.

name: Way of the Rat
description:
Within the soul of every Man there lurks a Beast, raging in
confinement. Few ever hear the voice of that Beast, or
learn to heed its call. Those that do, however, become
Shapechangers, donning the skins of animals or darker shapes.

name: Way of the Bear
description:
Within the soul of every Man there lurks a Beast, raging in
confinement. Few ever hear the voice of that Beast, or
learn to heed its call. Those that do, however, become
Shapechangers, donning the skins of animals or darker shapes.

name: Orthanatos
description:
An echo of the art of Necromancy lost long ago, the 
dark art of Orthanatos was passed on by the dreaded 
Thirteen to the Brotherhood of the Shroud.  Its users 
draw forth the cold emanations of the Void, using them 
to leech warmth from their victims.

name: Bloodcraft
description:
To Vampires, blood is not mere sustenance: it is the source 
of their unholy might. All Vampires must master the secrets 
of Bloodcraft, learning to draw more blood from their victims, 
and new ways to tap its primal power.

name: Exorcism
description:
First devised and practiced in the Lost Realm of Ardan, 
Exorcism focuses on exploiting the weaknesses of the Undead 
and the servants of the Void. Its secrets are critical to any 
who would stand against the Unholy Legions.

name: Necromancy
description:
Renegade Elvish wizards first learned the arts of Ghorregul, 
or 'Death Sorcery,' ages ago. Though long suppressed, these 
dark techniques have re-emerged as Necromancy, the magic of 
death and undeath.
